title: Reel: Back in 2004, email seemed like a solved problem. But an engineer at Google had different ideas...

timeline.caption: An engineer at Google had a vision for something better: simplicity through innovation
He introduced features like labels and the ability to reply all, transforming email from cluttered to organized
This wasn't just about inbox management; it was about how we interact with information
